caseName: Murray v. City of New York
caseNameFull: Murray, Receiver v. City of New York and Roberts, Receiver v. Murray, Receiver

opinions.text: The motion further to defer consideration of the petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit is granted and consideration is deferred until October 7 next. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration and decision of this application. Reported below: 103 F. 2d 889.
